warnings: 1.csv/2.csv are a separate Austin source; not merged into 4.csv/5.csv by Animal ID.
Food and work are scenario estimates, not ground-truth measurements.
CatBoost exit_count is observed outcomes only; unknown prior outcomes may cause undercount.
No same-day features leak into lag predictors; recursive inference must update lags using predictions.
Hazard CSV is one row per episode, not person-period expanded; training must expand at-risk days and model competing cause hazards.
Dates in 4/5 have no timezone; daily boundaries use naive source timestamps.
For valid temporal test, avoid using observations after test cutoff; this pipeline uses administrative censoring for earlier splits.
